name: pot_size
label: Cups
description: Size of the pot in 50 mL cups: the water below the safety valve, the coffee dose, the base, the gasket and the thread of the joint follow

name: handle_angle
label: Handle angle
description: Lean of the grip from the vertical, its lower end away from the pot

name: basket_depth
expr: (coffee_volume + (1 - pi / 4) * basket_corner^2 * 2 * pi * (basket_radius - fillet_centroid_share * basket_corner)) / (pi * basket_radius^2)

name: fill_depth
expr: max(basket_depth + cone_drop + headspace, collar_height + cast_round + valve_boss_radius + small_round + valve_tap_radius + headspace)

name: waterline_estimate
expr: pow((floor_flat^3 - 3 * boiler_taper * water_volume / facet_area_factor) / (1 mm)^3, 1 / 3) * 1 mm

name: water_displaced
expr: pi * (tube_radius^2 - (tube_radius - funnel_sheet)^2) * ((floor_flat - waterline_estimate) / boiler_taper - tube_gap) + 12 * (tan(facet_half_angle) - pi / 12) * cast_round^2 * (floor_flat - waterline_estimate) / boiler_taper + cast_round^2 * (1 / tan(45 deg - boiler_draft / 2) - (90 deg + boiler_draft) / (2 rad)) * 2 * facet_area_factor * (floor_flat - fillet_centroid_share * cast_round)

name: waterline_flat
expr: pow((floor_flat^3 - 3 * boiler_taper * (water_volume + water_displaced) / facet_area_factor) / (1 mm)^3, 1 / 3) * 1 mm

name: mouth_height
expr: (pow((chamber_floor_flat^3 + 3 * collector_taper * (collector_reserve * water_volume + pi * column_radius^2 * (pow((chamber_floor_flat^3 + 3 * collector_taper * collector_reserve * water_volume / facet_area_factor) / (1 mm)^3, 1 / 3) * 1 mm - chamber_floor_flat) / collector_taper) / facet_area_factor) / (1 mm)^3, 1 / 3) * 1 mm - chamber_floor_flat) / collector_taper

points: valve_height + (valve_boss_proud + safety_valve[1].flange_length + safety_valve[1].cap_length - safety_valve[1].chamfer) * sin(boiler_draft) + (safety_valve[1].cap_d / 2) * cos(boiler_draft)
valve_height + (valve_boss_proud + safety_valve[1].flange_length + safety_valve[1].cap_length) * sin(boiler_draft) + (safety_valve[1].cap_d / 2 - safety_valve[1].chamfer) * cos(boiler_draft)

valve_height + (valve_boss_proud + safety_valve[1].flange_length + safety_valve[1].cap_length + safety_valve[1].plunger_length) * sin(boiler_draft) + (safety_valve[1].plunger_d / 2) * cos(boiler_draft)
-valve_facet - (valve_boss_proud + safety_valve[1].flange_length + safety_valve[1].cap_length + safety_valve[1].plunger_length) * cos(boiler_draft) + (0 mm) * sin(boiler_draft)
valve_height + (valve_boss_proud + safety_valve[1].flange_length + safety_valve[1].cap_length + safety_valve[1].plunger_length) * sin(boiler_draft) + (0 mm) * cos(boiler_draft)
basket_floor - funnel_sheet - (basket_radius + 2 * funnel_sheet - tube_radius) * tan(cone_slope) + funnel_sheet / cos(cone_slope)
collector_rim - spout_wall / 2 + spout_lift + spout_channel_rise - spout_tip_scale * spout_depth

line: handle_axis_height - handle_bend + handle_bend * sin(handle_angle) - handle_grip * cos(handle_angle)
handle_start - handle_shank - handle_bend * cos(handle_angle) - handle_grip * sin(handle_angle)

name: collector_capacity
label: Collector capacity below the column's mouth

name: basket_capacity
expr: pi * ((basket_wall_span / 2)^2 - basket_wall_area / pi) * basket_measured_depth - (1 - pi / 4) * basket_corner^2 * 2 * pi * (sqrt((basket_wall_span / 2)^2 - basket_wall_area / pi) - fillet_centroid_share * basket_corner)
label: Coffee basket capacity, level to the rim

name: tip_angle_empty
expr: atan((base_flat - cast_round / tan(45 deg - boiler_draft / 2) + pot_centre_x) / pot_centre_z)
label: Tipping angle toward the handle, empty

name: tip_angle_brewed
expr: atan((base_flat - cast_round / tan(45 deg - boiler_draft / 2) + pot_mass * pot_centre_x / (pot_mass + water_volume * water_density)) / ((pot_mass * pot_centre_z + water_volume * water_density * brew_centre_z) / (pot_mass + water_volume * water_density)))
label: Tipping angle toward the handle, brewed

name: Water below the valve for the cups
Collector holds all the water below the column's mouth
Funnel ends at least 2 mm above the boiler's floor
Stands on a 10 degree slope empty
Stands on a 10 degree slope brewed
Boiler outside drafted toward its die
Collector outside and lug drafted toward the die
Collector chamber and column drafted toward the core
Handle clears the boiler for the fingers
Safety valve clear of the collector
Castings clear of the other parts

title: Moka pot
description: An original stovetop espresso maker of twelve-sided cast aluminium, 3 to 6 cups, sized by its physics: the safety valve sits where the water for the cups ends, the funnel holds the coffee for that water, and the pot stands on a 10 degree slope.
author: 3DCraft examples
